# W47 public IPv6 Array fixture

Generated by `scripts/generate_public_wide_array_ipv6_w47_fixture.sh` with
ClickHouse local `26.7.1.1315` (official build). The part contains only
synthetic IPv6 addresses and a sorted UInt64 key; no user data is included.

The physical profile is Wide, LZ4-compressed data streams, and plain adaptive
`.mrk2` marks. The schema is exactly `pk UInt64`, `plain Array(IPv6)`, and
`maybe Array(Nullable(IPv6))`. Adaptive mark row counts are `[2, 2, 2, 1]`
followed by the zero-row EOF sentinel. The stock serializer writes each IPv6
leaf as 16 network-order octets. Nullable arrays keep a 16-byte default child
slot beneath each NULL bit on disk; RowBinary writes only the NULL flag and
omits that child payload.

The asymmetric addresses distinguish network-order octets from complete byte
reversal and 64-bit-half swapping. `::`, `::1`, empty arrays, and nonempty
all-NULL arrays are deliberate controls. The fixture is immutable test input;
rerunning the generator refuses to replace it. Verify it with
`scripts/verify_stock_wide_array_ipv6_w47_fixture.sh`.
